title: Why the Rent Beats the Royalty
the_thought: The thicker check is the rent, not the royalty.
hook: You pay at the window and take a paper bag into the car.

levels.name: The Short
beats: McDonald's Corporation usually does not book that tray as its own sale. Most of those tickets sit on somebody else's register. Fiscal 2025 filings split the franchise invoice into two stacks. Rents were 10.442 billion dollars. Royalties were 6.018 billion on the same table. The thicker check is the rent, not the royalty. The guest paid the restaurant. The operator paid headquarters for a site the Company generally keeps on a 20-year clock.
